simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יִתְרָה (H3502) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יִתְרָה (yithrâh) means properly, excellence , i.e. (by implication) wealth First listed occurrence: Isa 15 7.

definitions.full: H3502. yithrah יִתְרָה noun feminine abundance, riches ; — עָשָׂה יִתְרָה Isa 15:7 = עָשָׂה יִתְרַת Jer 48:36 (on construct compare Da Synt. § 25 ) the abundance (which) he hath gotten.
